title: Tiny, cute teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pot' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0557f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lid' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d94a75'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='spout' x1='100%' y1='0%' x2='0%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c93f68'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='28' ry='7' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='24' ry='5.5' fill='#a8e0f5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#pot)'/>
  <!-- body shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#ffc4dc' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M72 56 Q84 52 84 42 Q84 38 80 40 Q76 46 72 48 Z' fill='url(#spout)'/>
  <!-- spout tip highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#ffd0e2'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q14 52 14 64 Q14 76 28 74' stroke='#e0557f' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 53 Q16 53 16 64 Q16 74 28 73' stroke='#ffb3d1' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='17' ry='5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <path d='M33 42 Q34 33 50 32 Q66 33 67 42 Z' fill='url(#lid)'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M40 38 Q42 34 50 34 Q58 34 60 38 Q56 36 50 36 Q44 36 40 38 Z' fill='#ffd9e8'/>
  <!-- knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='5' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='28.5' r='1.8' fill='#c4eefa'/>
  <!-- teapot face: cute eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#5a1a33'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#5a1a33'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='57' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='57' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff5d94' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff5d94' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 66 Q50 71 55 66' stroke='#5a1a33' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M44 24 Q42 18 46 14' stroke='#c4eefa' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M52 22 Q54 16 50 11' stroke='#c4eefa' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
